items.source: Retrieves the metadata associated with the result of an AI model.
items.translation: 检索与 AI 模型结果相关的元数据。

items.source: Retrieves the output generated by the AI model.
items.translation: 检索由 AI 模型生成的输出。

items.source:
This interface provides methods to access the main output of the AI model and the
metadata associated with this result. It is designed to offer a standardized and
comprehensive way to handle and interpret the outputs generated by AI models, catering
to diverse AI applications and use cases.
items.translation: 该接口提供了访问 AI 模型主要输出及其相关元数据的方法。它旨在为处理和解译 AI 模型生成的输出提供标准化且全面的方式，以满足各种 AI 应用和用例的需求。

items.source: T - the type of the output generated by the AI model
items.translation: T - AI 模型生成的输出类型

items.source: the output generated by the AI model
the metadata associated with the result
